messages:
Sam (Finance): Quick flag — batch_20260518_14 finished but Support shows two customers reported invoice totals that don't match their portal. Looks like duplicate invoices where one invoice is missing the reserved capacity credit lines.

Ivy (Billing Eng): Which batch/id? I can pull generator logs.

Sam (Finance): batch_20260518_14. Example acct: OrbitLabs (acct_id=74455). System generated INV-74455-20260518-A ($9,420.00) and INV-74455-20260518-B ($3,100.00). The -B invoice has only subscription and seat charges; missing negative reserved-credit rows.

BillingBot: [system] invoice_generator v2.20 job job_20260518_14_7 WARNING duplicate_invoice_detected acct=74455 reason=reserved_credit_split

Ivy (Billing Eng): Noted. We deployed a change that emits reserved credits as normalized negative rows with batch_id ties. If a normalization job runs while sharding happens, negative rows can land in a different shard. Generator then treats shards as separate invoice payloads.

Rae (RevOps): Support already has a ticket. Customers are understandably worried about being charged twice. Recommend we hold auto-issue when reason=reserved_credit_split and scan the batch for other affected accounts.

Jon (Acct Mgr): Finance, do we need sign-off to void the provisional invoice and reissue a consolidated one?

Sam (Finance): Approve void + credit memo + reissue for OrbitLabs and any other affected accounts in this batch. Net impact expected 0. Please include a short customer note and a reconciliation CSV.

Ivy (Billing Eng): Plan: 1) run quick-scan: `billing_scan --batch batch_20260518_14 --filter reserved_credit_split`, 2) dry-run recombine: `billing_regen --batch batch_20260518_14 --recombine --dry-run --acct-list affected.csv`, 3) apply fixes: create credit memos for provisional invoices and emit reissued consolidated invoices with memo "reissued due to billing shard split". Filing ticket BIL-9201 to gate auto-issue on reserved_credit_split.

Ivy (Billing Eng): Dry-run found 4 accounts including 74455. Holding apply until recon CSV and finance ack for all. Logs snippet for visibility:
```
2026-05-18T14:07:12Z [invoice_generator] job_job_20260518_14_7 WARN reserved_credit_split acct=74455 shards=2 negative_rows=18
```
Rae (RevOps): I'll prepare customer note template: brief apology, confirmation net-zero impact, new invoice id, and link to support if they have questions.

Sam (Finance): Ack. Approve apply for the four accounts once Ivy uploads the affected_list.csv and the reconciliation summary.

Ivy (Billing Eng): Applying fixes now for the four accts. Created credit memos CM-74455-20260518 and reissued invoice INV-74455-20260518-re1. Marked INV-74455-20260518-B as void. Uploading recon to s3 and adding postmortem to BIL-9201.

BillingBot: [system] reconciliation_report uploaded: s3://redwood-billing/reports/2026-05-18/batch_20260518_14_recon_1889994321.csv

Jon (Acct Mgr): Notified customer. They appreciated the prompt fix. Closing loop once BIL-9201 has the postmortem and a test to prevent reserved_credit_split.

Sam (Finance): Great — thanks team. Please also add a metric alert for reserved_credit_split occurrences so we catch this earlier.
